title: Figure 21: SiC reflectivity versus wavelength and constant-reflectivity contour plot
description: Left: plot titled "Reflection from SiC on Au" of reflectivity versus wavenumber (600-1200 cm^-1), comparing theory (dotted) and experimental data (green line) with a deep dip near 800 cm^-1. Right: contour plot titled "Absorption vs. nr and ni for λ=13μm" in the Real(n), Imag(n) plane with nested colored ellipses and an inset of a SiC layer (d=490nm). Caption: "Figure 21. (Left) Experimental Result, Reflectivity Versus Wavelength, that Inspired the Proposed Effort... (Right): Theoretical Plot - Constant Reflectivity Contours Plotted in the (Real(n), Imag(n)) Space."
